frase_clave: Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.
reflexion: Jesus walks into your everyday life today and invites you to trust in Him. What nets do you need to leave behind to truly follow Him and share His love?

escenas.descripcion: Jesus stands by the sunlit shore of the Sea of Galilee, gesturing gently with an inviting smile towards Simon Peter and Andrew, who pause while casting their nets into the sparkling blue water.
Simon Peter and Andrew leave their fishing nets resting on the sandy beach, walking faithfully behind Jesus along the tranquil Galilean shore under warm sunlight.
From the beach, Jesus warmly calls James and John as they step out of their wooden boat, bidding a respectful farewell to their elderly father Zebedee who sits peacefully among the mended nets.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Matthew.
texto_evangelio: At that time, walking by the sea of Galilee, Jesus saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen. He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.” They immediately left their nets and followed him. Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them. They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

frase_es: Seguidme, y os haré pescadores de hombres.
reflexion_es: Jesús pasa hoy junto a tu vida cotidiana y te invita a confiar en Él. ¿Qué redes necesitas soltar para seguirle de verdad y llevar su amor a los demás?
